name: Blindstory
description: A framed wall with a course of blind panels let into it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%); mask: linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; right: 22%; top: 44%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12% 22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12% 22%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
